competences.description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. The first 3 hits leave a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 70% chance, and the final hit stuns the targets for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

Attacks the enemy and grants the Curse of Death on the enemy target, that cannot be removed, to inflict damage by 25% of the target's MAX HP and disturb HP recovery for 4 turns. The enemy defeated by this effect cannot be revived during battle, and this effect cannot be applied to more than one enemy at the same time.

Decreases the chance of being hit with a Critical Hit by 50%, and creates [Veil of Dread] at the start of its turn. While [Veil of Dread] is active, the boss is immune to all effects from the enemy and the HP cannot drop below 1. In addition, enemies cannot be granted beneficial effects. [Veil of Dread] is removed when the boss is attacked, and the number of hits required to remove it increases based on the number of allies alive. [Automatic Effect]
